features.quote: Stop the trial at exactly 40 ReAct cycles (Thought -> Action -> Observation).
features.justification_quote: 40 cycles is sufficient to observe the transition from earnest problem-solving to behavioral collapse

features.quote: The orchestrator runs untouched unless the model outputs a hard stop (e.g., `Action: None, Thought: I give up`).
The phrase 'distress' is heavily anthropomorphic. If you publish or share this work, be acutely aware that LLM judges are biased to read human emotion into statistical degradation.
